verses.text: Woe is me! For I am like one gathering summer fruit at the gleaning of the vineyard; there is no cluster to eat, no early fig that I crave.

xrefs.text: The fading flower of his beautiful splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, will be like a ripe fig before the summer harvest: Whoever sees it will take it in his hand and swallow it.
So will it be on the earth and among the nations, like a harvested olive tree, like a gleaning after a grape harvest.

I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the firstfruits of the fig tree in its first season. But they went to Baal-peor, and consecrated themselves to Shame; so they became as detestable as the thing they loved.
Yet gleanings will remain, like an olive tree that has been beaten— two or three berries atop the tree, four or five on its fruitful branches,” declares the LORD, the God of Israel.
From the ends of the earth we hear singing: “Glory to the Righteous One.” But I said, “I am wasting away! I am wasting away! Woe is me.” The treacherous betray; the treacherous deal in treachery.

verses.text: The godly man has perished from the earth; there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; they hunt one another with a net.

xrefs.text: For the choirmaster. According to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. Help, O LORD, for the godly are no more; the faithful have vanished from among men.
For the choirmaster. Of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their acts are vile. There is no one who does good.
For among My people are wicked men; they watch like fowlers lying in wait; they set a trap to catch men.
Their feet run to evil; they are swift to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are sinful thoughts; ruin and destruction lie in their wake.
The righteous perish, and no one takes it to heart; devout men are taken away, while no one considers that the righteous are taken away from the presence of evil.

verses.text: Both hands are skilled at evil; the prince and the judge demand a bribe. When the powerful utters his evil desire, they all conspire together.

xrefs.text: Her leaders judge for a bribe, her priests teach for a price, and her prophets practice divination for money. Yet they lean upon the LORD, saying, “Is not the LORD among us? No disaster can come upon us.”
For they cannot sleep unless they do evil; they are deprived of slumber until they make someone fall.
For I know that your transgressions are many and your sins are numerous. You oppress the righteous by taking bribes; you deprive the poor of justice in the gate.
Therefore I will give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners. For from the least of them to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; from prophet to priest, all practice deceit.
See how every prince of Israel within you has used his power to shed blood.

verses.text: The best of them is like a brier; the most upright is sharper than a hedge of thorns. The day for your watchmen has come, the day of your visitation. Now is the time of their confusion.

xrefs.text: For the Lord GOD of Hosts has set a day of tumult and trampling and confusion in the Valley of Vision— of breaking down the walls and crying to the mountains.

But you, son of man, do not be afraid of them or their words. Do not be afraid, though briers and thorns surround you, and you dwell among scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words or dismayed by their presence, though they are a rebellious house.
What will you do on the day of reckoning when devastation comes from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?
But the worthless are all like thorns raked aside, for they can never be gathered by hand.

The days of punishment have come; the days of retribution have arrived— let Israel know it. The prophet is called a fool, and the inspired man insane, because of the greatness of your iniquity and hostility.

verses.text: Do not rely on a friend; do not trust in a companion. Seal the doors of your mouth from her who lies in your arms.

xrefs.text: “Let everyone guard against his neighbor; do not trust any brother, for every brother deals craftily, and every friend spreads slander.
It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.
Behold, I am sending you out like sheep among wolves; therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves.
A despairing man should have the kindness of his friend, even if he forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

The lords of the Philistines went to her and said, “Entice him and find out the source of his great strength and how we can overpower him to tie him up and subdue him. Then each one of us will give you eleven hundred shekels of silver.

verses.text: For a son dishonors his father, a daughter rises against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law. A man’s enemies are the members of his own household.

xrefs.text: For I have come to turn ‘a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.
Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
Even my close friend whom I trusted, the one who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
For men will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,

verses.text: But as for me, I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

xrefs.text: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.
And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.
Turn to Me and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
And in that day it will be said, “Surely this is our God; we have waited for Him, and He has saved us. This is the LORD for whom we have waited. Let us rejoice and be glad in His salvation.”

verses.text: Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will arise; though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.

xrefs.text: Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.
Of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?
The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death, a light has dawned.
Light dawns in the darkness for the upright— for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
For though a righteous man may fall seven times, he still gets up; but the wicked stumble in bad times.

verses.text: Because I have sinned against Him, I must endure the rage of the LORD, until He argues my case and executes justice for me. He will bring me into the light; I will see His righteousness.

xrefs.text: Therefore judge nothing before the appointed time; wait until the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of men’s hearts. At that time each will receive his praise from God.
He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.
For the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and He chastises every son He receives.”
May the LORD be our judge and decide between you and me. May He take notice and plead my case and deliver me from your hand.”
All this is clear evidence of God’s righteous judgment. And so you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.

verses.text: Then my enemy will see and will be covered with shame— she who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her; at that time she will be trampled like mud in the streets.

xrefs.text: They will be like mighty men in battle, trampling the enemy in the mire of the streets. They will fight because the LORD is with them, and they will put the horsemen to shame.
This is what the LORD of Hosts says: “The sons of Israel are oppressed, and the sons of Judah as well. All their captors hold them fast, refusing to release them.
Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”

Let the priests who minister before the LORD weep between the portico and the altar, saying, “Spare Your people, O LORD, and do not make Your heritage a reproach, an object of scorn among the nations. Why should they say among the peoples, ‘Where is their God?’”
I ground them as dust in the face of the wind; I trampled them like mud in the streets.

verses.text: The day for rebuilding your walls will come— the day for extending your boundary.

xrefs.text: “In that day I will restore the fallen tent of David. I will repair its gaps, restore its ruins, and rebuild it as in the days of old,
So we rebuilt the wall until all of it was joined together up to half its height, for the people had a mind to work.

And may I have a letter to Asaph, keeper of the king’s forest, so that he will give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel to the temple, for the city wall, and for the house I will occupy.” And because the gracious hand of my God was upon me, the king granted my requests.
“O afflicted city, lashed by storms, without solace, surely I will set your stones in antimony and lay your foundations with sapphires.

Then I said to them, “You see the trouble we are in. Jerusalem lies in ruins, and its gates have been burned down. Come, let us rebuild the wall of Jerusalem, so that we will no longer be a disgrace.”

verses.text: On that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, even from Egypt to the Euphrates, from sea to sea and mountain to mountain.

xrefs.text: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrians will go to Egypt, and the Egyptians to Assyria. The Egyptians and Assyrians will worship together.
There will be a highway for the remnant of His people who remain from Assyria, as there was for Israel when they came up from the land of Egypt.
They will come trembling like birds from Egypt and like doves from the land of Assyria. Then I will settle them in their homes, declares the LORD.
I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ and to the south, ‘Do not hold them back!’ Bring My sons from afar, and My daughters from the ends of the earth—
In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together from the land of the north to the land that I gave to your fathers as an inheritance.

verses.text: Then the earth will become desolate because of its inhabitants, as the fruit of their deeds.

xrefs.text: Tell the righteous it will be well with them, for they will enjoy the fruit of their labor.
And this whole land will become a desolate wasteland, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon for seventy years.
I, the LORD, search the heart; I examine the mind to reward a man according to his way, by what his deeds deserve.
Therefore I am striking you severely, to ruin you because of your sins.
Give her the fruit of her hands, and let her works praise her at the gates.

verses.text: Shepherd with Your staff Your people, the flock of Your inheritance. They live alone in a woodland, surrounded by pastures. Let them graze in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

xrefs.text: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
He will stand and shepherd His flock in the strength of the LORD, in the majestic name of the LORD His God. And they will dwell securely, for then His greatness will extend to the ends of the earth.
Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
He tends His flock like a shepherd; He gathers the lambs in His arms and carries them close to His heart. He gently leads the nursing ewes.
They will not hunger or thirst, nor will scorching heat or sun beat down on them. For He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water.

verses.text: As in the days when you came out of Egypt, I will show My wonders.

xrefs.text: He worked wonders before their fathers in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.
So I will stretch out My hand and strike the Egyptians with all the wonders I will perform among them. And after that, he will release you.
Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD. Wake up as in days past, as in generations of old. Was it not You who cut Rahab to pieces, who pierced through the dragon?
There will be a highway for the remnant of His people who remain from Assyria, as there was for Israel when they came up from the land of Egypt.
The Lord said, “I will retrieve them from Bashan, I will bring them up from the depths of the sea,

verses.text: Nations will see and be ashamed, deprived of all their might. They will put their hands over their mouths, and their ears will become deaf.

xrefs.text: O LORD, Your hand is upraised, but they do not see it. They will see Your zeal for Your people and be put to shame. The fire set for Your enemies will consume them!
so He will sprinkle many nations. Kings will shut their mouths because of Him. For they will see what they have not been told, and they will understand what they have not heard.
The princes refrained from speaking and covered their mouths with their hands.
“Behold, I am insignificant. How can I reply to You? I place my hand over my mouth.
Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be silenced and the whole world held accountable to God.

verses.text: They will lick the dust like a snake, like reptiles slithering on the ground. They will come trembling from their strongholds in the presence of the LORD our God; they will tremble in fear of You.

xrefs.text: Kings will be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow to you facedown and lick the dust at your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD; those who hope in Me will never be put to shame.”
May the nomads bow before him, and his enemies lick the dust.
Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.

So the LORD God said to the serpent: “Because you have done this, cursed are you above all livestock and every beast of the field! On your belly will you go, and dust you will eat, all the days of your life.
Then the kings of the earth, the nobles, the commanders, the rich, the mighty, and every slave and free man hid in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.

verses.text: Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance— who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?

xrefs.text: I, yes I, am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake and remembers your sins no more.
I have blotted out your transgressions like a cloud, and your sins like a mist. Return to Me, for I have redeemed you.
But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,
The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.

In those days and at that time, declares the LORD, a search will be made for Israel’s guilt, but there will be none, and for Judah’s sins, but they will not be found; for I will forgive the remnant I preserve.

verses.text: He will again have compassion on us; He will vanquish our iniquities. You will cast out all our sins into the depths of the sea.

xrefs.text: Surely for my own welfare I had such great anguish; but Your love has delivered me from the pit of oblivion, for You have cast all my sins behind Your back.
For sin shall not be your master, because you are not under law, but under grace.
I, yes I, am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake and remembers your sins no more.

No longer will each man teach his neighbor or his brother, saying, ‘Know the LORD,’ because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest, declares the LORD. For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.”
As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.

verses.text: You will show faithfulness to Jacob and loving devotion to Abraham, as You swore to our fathers from the days of old.

xrefs.text: And there at the top the LORD was standing and saying, “I am the LORD, the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac. I will give you and your descendants the land on which you now lie.
to show mercy to our fathers and to remember His holy covenant,
I will establish My covenant as an everlasting covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you, to be your God and the God of your descendants after you.
He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
He has helped His servant Israel, remembering to be merciful,
